header: Our scores on three review directories
lead: Each directory asks different questions, uses its own scale and reaches different customers. Still, the three scores differ by less than half a point.
note: Read on 2 March 2026. None of the three lets us edit reviews, and we have never paid any of them. About 200 customers appear on more than one directory and are counted twice.

scores.title: Branchenurteil
scores.text: 67 ratings, open to anyone with an account
